title: Rassimov/Quotes
summary:
"There will be no failure. I will take care of this personally."
- Rassimov to the Professor (Memory Lane)

"I've been looking forward to removing you from the Professor's path but I thought you might help us obtain the treasures in that room first."
- Rassimov to Dante Vale and Lok Lambert (Memory Lane)

"The Titan will not bond! None dare resist me!"
- Rassimov, about Cavalier (Memory Lane)

"Dante! Beware the Professor. He's stronger than you think."
- Rassimov to Dante Vale (The Divine Comedy)

"To be a leader, might is not enough."
- Rassimov to Harrison Fears (Rassimov's Secret)

"You can do better. My audience will be disappointed." (Rassimov)

"They'll only be disappointed when you lose." (Dante Vale)
